title: Employ staff under the Hydrocarbons Field Geologists Award 2020
what: Pay and employ staff at no less than the terms of the Hydrocarbons Field Geologists Award 2020.

sources.title: Hydrocarbons Field Geologists Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.1 This occupational award covers employers of field geologists throughout Australia and in the adjacent areas as defined in the Petroleum (Submerged Lands) Act 1967 (Cth) and their employees in the classifications listed in clause 10 — Classifications to the exclusion of any other modern award.

reach.note: National system employers that are companies, in every state.

sources.title: Which system of employment laws applies
sources.publisher: Government of Western Australia (Private Sector Labour Relations)
sources.quote: The state system covers: Private sector businesses and their employees that operate as: Sole traders. Partnerships, where none of the partners in the business is a constitutional corporation (trading or financial corporation).

confidence_note: Occupational award: field geologists, mainly in oil and gas exploration onshore and offshore (cl 4.1).

assessment.summary: The Hydrocarbons Field Geologists Award sets classifications, minimum pay and allowances for employed field geologists.

marks.reason: Classifications, allowances, penalty rates and their record-keeping add to the cost and complexity of employing in the industry.
